harness-settings.title: Codex CLI
harness-settings.serverScope: Defaults on the connected server. Project and Agent overrides take precedence.
harness-settings.projectScope: Project overrides for Codex CLI. Reset a field to use the server default.
harness-settings.agentScope: Agent overrides for Codex CLI. Project defaults apply in the execution's original project; native defaults require the selected Runner's verified source evidence.
harness-settings.unavailable: Unavailable until verified for this source
harness-settings.unsupported: This functionality is unavailable on this server. Retained values can be reset; this menu cannot enable native support.
harness-settings.nativeBoundary: Saving a default does not install Codex, authenticate an account, or grant native functionality. The original process verifies supported settings before input.
harness-settings.parentUnavailable: Inherited server values are unavailable. Your draft is retained.
harness-settings.wrongSource: Choose a Codex model from this original source. Your selection is retained.
